description: A painted interior of a large mosque-like hall with a carved wooden pulpit on stairs, where a robed preacher gestures while seated and kneeling men in turbans listen. A tall bearded man in chainmail, a headwrap and a long cloak stands at centre right with a sword, and black banners are held near a doorway at right. Lanterns light the scene, and the walls carry decorative calligraphy bands and arches. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text, border or frame.
